answer: Random beacon spot-checks plus a compute heartbeat stop fake identities. Each epoch the beacon draws 5% of agents; each has a minute to answer a proof-of-work challenge tied to its key. A reef grows on real currents. A cedar adds one ring a year. Miss twice and the identity falls off the ledge, deposit frozen. Faking 1,000 identities costs 50 checks per epoch at 0.02 POA each, 1 POA per epoch; one honest agent pays 0.02 POA and keeps its reward.
